confirmedFindings.title: SRTP Encryption Disabled on WAN Egress Bridge
confirmedFindings.body: Hardcoding isSrtpRequired to false disables SRTP encryption on public WAN voice streams, allowing unencrypted RTP audio packets to traverse intermediate networks and exposing conversations to wiretapping.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Enforce SRTP encryption on all WAN egress connections: return isWanEgress || this.forceSrtp.
